blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pore-space evolution and fluid displacement influence how rocks transmit and store fluids, affecting geological carbon storage, underground hydrogen storage and groundwater contaminant transport. A single time-resolved micro-CT experiment may produce tens to hundreds of three-dimensional images, and segmentation is required to quantify physical properties and run image-based simulations. Traditional methods such as thresholding perform poorly on noisy, low-contrast images and need manual adjustment per image; 3D deep learning networks segment each image without temporal information, so their errors vary between images and could be mistaken for physical change. Here we introduce a transformer-based 4D segmentation framework combining spatial and temporal information. It uses sequential images to resolve ambiguous phase assignments and separate physical change from segmentation error. The method is tested on images of mineral dissolution: it measures pore-volume growth and rock boundaries more accurately than an equivalent 3D model that ignores temporal information. It also captures the increase in permeability verified against reference segmentations and flow simulations. The advantage transfers to another dissolution sample without retraining. On two other datasets of fluid displacement, it reduces spurious changes in predicted rock and porosity fluctuations and accurately identifies filling events. Spatiotemporal segmentation turns sequences of hundreds of three-dimensional images into more reliable quantitative measurements of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement without per-image parameter adjustment to support the analysis of time-resolved CT imaging.
blocks.zh: 孔隙空间演化和流体转移影响岩石传递和储存流体的方式,影响地质碳储存,地下氢储存和地下水污染物迁移. 单个时间解的微CT实验可以产生数十到数百个三维图像,分解需要量化物理性质和运行基于图像的模拟. 诸如阈值等传统方法在吵吵闹闹的低调图像上表现不佳,每个图像都需要手动调整;3D深层学习网络将每个图像片断,没有时间信息,因此其错误因图像而异,可能误认为是物理变化. 在这里,我们引入了基于变压器的4D分解框架,结合了空间和时间信息. 它使用顺序图像来解决模棱两可的相位任务,并将物理变化与分割错误区分开来. 该方法通过矿物溶解的图像进行测试:它比忽略时间信息的等效立体模型更准确地测量孔径生长和岩石边界. 它还记录了参照分解和流量模拟核实的渗透性增加。 好处是在没有再培训的情况下转移到另一个解散样本。 在另外两个流体迁移数据集上,它减少了预测的岩石和孔隙波动的虚假变化,并准确地识别填充事件. spatiotemporal partication 将数百个三维图像的序列转换成更可靠的定量测量孔隙空间演化和流体位移,而无需每个图像参数调整,以支持时间解的CT成像分析.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Fluid transport and reactions in porous rocks are central to geological carbon dioxide storage, underground hydrogen storage and contaminant transport in groundwater Bachu (2000) ; Chai et al. (2022) ; Zivar et al. (2021) ; Honeyman (1999) . In geological carbon storage, capillary forces retain carbon dioxide in pores and dissolution transfers it into formation water Mingotti and
Woods (2025) . Fluid filling and snap-off, in which a fluid connection breaks, can reorganise the pathways available for flow Berg et al. (2013) ; Singh et al. (2017) . The solid structure can also evolve: mineral dissolution can change pore geometry and rock permeability Menke et al. (2015) ; Ma et al. (2026) ; Salalá et al. (2025) . Quantifying these processes requires accurate measurements of how fluid occupancy and pore geometry evolve over time.

blocks.en: Time-resolved X-ray micro-tomography provides three-dimensional (3D) images of these evolving rock–fluid systems Berg et al. (2013) ; Andrew et al. (2015) ; Bultreys et al. (2015) ; Menke et al. (2015) ; Singh et al. (2017) . Each 3D image corresponds to a time step in the image sequence. Segmentations of successive images provide porosity, the fraction of a volume occupied by pores, and saturation, the fraction of pore space occupied by a given fluid. Segmented images enable measurements of pore structure and fluid occupancy and provide computational domains for flow and reactive transport simulations Maes and Menke (2021) . The accuracy of phase volumes and boundaries therefore matters both for measuring changes and for the physical calculations based on them Gao et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: Time-resolved X射线微透视提供这些演化中的岩石流系统的三维(3D)图像 Berg等人(2013年);Andrew等人(2015年);Bultreys等人(2015年);Menke等人(2015年);Singh等人(2017年)。 每个3D图像对应图像序列中的一个时间步骤. 相继图像的分化提供了孔隙,孔隙占用的体积的分量,以及饱和,孔隙空间被给定的流体占用的分量. 片段图像可以测量孔隙结构和流体占用情况,并为流体和反应性迁移模拟梅斯和门克(2021)提供计算域. 因此,相位量和边界的准确性对于衡量变化和基于变化的物理计算都至关重要(2024年)。

blocks.en:
Segmentation assigns each voxel, a 3D image element, to a material phase. Errors that vary between images can distort measurements of changes in pore space over time and obscure fluid displacement. Greyscale values can also vary between successive images even when the material remains unchanged, complicating consistent phase identification across the sequence Zhang et al. (2019) . Fluid motion during a CT scan can cause temporal blurring: projections acquired at different stages of displacement are combined in one reconstruction, producing intermediate greyscale values Goethals et al. (2022) ; Gao et al. (2017) . When these intermediate greyscale values resemble those of rock, segmentation can misclassify a fluid-filled pore as rock. If the same pore is correctly identified in a later image, the segmentation suggests that new pore space has formed, although only the fluid occupying the pore has changed. In laboratory CT, shorter duration scans can increase image noise, making phase identification more difficult as temporal resolution improves Van Offenwert
et al. (2019) ; Goethals et al. (2022) ; Tekseth and Breiby (2024) . Noise and weak phase contrast complicate thresholding and watershed segmentation, while manual adjustment for each image becomes laborious across sequences of tens to hundreds of images Iassonov
et al. (2009) ; Schlüter et al. (2014) . For example, Tang et al. reported that a conventional workflow involving registration, segmentation and morphological adjustment required approximately 30 hours to process 20 3D images Tang et al. (2025) . Annotation-free supervoxel methods offer rapid segmentation of noisy multiphase images Ye et al. (2025) . Deep learning has improved the spatial resolution of multiphase images Ma et al. (2025) and their segmentation Niu et al. (2020) ; Da Wang et al. (2021) ; Zhang et al. (2026) . However, 3D networks that process each image independently do not use information from other images in the time sequence. Using this information offers a way to resolve ambiguous phase assignments across the sequence. The benefit of temporal information should therefore be assessed through both segmentation accuracy and the resulting measurements of pore geometry and fluid occupancy.

blocks.en: Here we introduce PoreTimeNet, a spatiotemporal (4D) segmentation network that uses successive images to improve measurements of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement. We compare it with a 3D network that uses the same spatial architecture but processes each image independently. During carbonate dissolution, the 4D model identified rock boundaries more accurately and reduced mean absolute porosity error from 0.97 to 0.28 percentage points. The resulting segmentations also gave more accurate estimates of the increase in permeability. During drainage and imbibition, the 4D model reduced spurious changes in predicted rock between consecutive images by approximately one-third compared with the 3D model. In low-contrast laboratory CT images, the 4D model identified pores with intermediate greyscale values that the 3D model misclassified as rock, allowing more of the observed oil filling to be measured.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们引入了PoreTimeNet,这是一个spatiotempor(4D)的分区网络,使用连续的图像来改进对孔隙空间演化和流体位移的测量. 我们把它与一个使用相同空间架构但独立处理每个图像的3D网络进行比较. 在碳酸盐溶解过程中,4D模型更准确地确定了岩石边界,并将平均绝对孔径误差从0.97个百分点降至0.28个百分点. 由此产生的分裂还更准确地估计了渗透性增加的情况。 在排水和沉积期间,4D模型将连续图像之间预测岩石的假变化与3D模型相比减少了约三分之一. 在低孔径的实验室CT图像中,4D模型确定了3D模型误归类为岩石的具有中间灰度值的毛孔,从而可以测量更多的观测到的石油填充量.

blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 A framework for time-resolved image segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 时间解析图像分割框架

blocks.en:
The framework takes an aligned sequence of three-dimensional greyscale images and assigns each voxel to specified phases (Fig. 1 ). A shared spatial encoder describes local geometry, while temporal attention and decoder fusion combine information from other images in the time sequence. The spatial encoder and decoder follow the SwinUNETR design Hatamizadeh
et al. (2022) ; the 3D SwinUNETR model is referred to as the 3D model throughout. During training, reference segmentations supervise predictions at the labelled time steps within each input window. Other images in the same input window provide temporal information even without training labels. Overlapping spatial predictions are combined to cover the evaluation volume.
blocks.zh:
框架采用三维灰度图像的对齐序列,将每个voxel指定为指定的相(图1 ). 一个共享的空间编码器描述了局部几何,而时间注意力和解码器聚变则结合了时间序列中来自其他图像的信息. 空间编码器和解码器遵循SwinUNETR设计 Hatamizadeh
et al. (2022);3D SwinUNETR模型全称为3D模型. 在培训期间,参考片段监督每个输入窗口内标注的时间步骤的预测。 在同一输入窗口中的其他图像即使没有训练标签也提供时间信息. 重叠的空间预测被合并以覆盖评价量.

blocks.en: Evaluation connects phase and boundary accuracy, consistency through time, and physical calculations from the segmented geometry. Together, these measurements assess both the predictions and their consequences for inferred rock properties.
blocks.zh: 评价将相位和边界的准确性,时间的一致性,以及从分位几何的物理计算联系起来. 这些测量方法共同评估了预测及其对所推断的岩石特性的后果。

blocks.en: 2.2 Measuring pore-space evolution during dissolution
blocks.zh: 2.2 测量溶解期间孔隙空间的演变

blocks.en: We tested whether the 4D model could measure pore-volume growth and identify rock boundaries more accurately than the 3D model. The experiment followed oil displacement by CO 2 -saturated brine as the carbonate dissolved Ma et al. (2026) . Predictions were compared with reference segmentations at ten time steps (Fig. 2 ; Methods).
blocks.zh: 我们测试了4D模型能否比3D模型更精确地测量孔径生长并识别岩石边界. 实验是随着碳酸盐溶解Ma等人(2026年)而由CO 2 - 饱和的盐水引起的。 在10个时间步骤(图2;方法)上,将预测与参考区划进行了比较。

blocks.en: The 4D model tracked pore-volume evolution more closely than the 3D model. Mean absolute porosity error decreased from 0.97 to 0.28 percentage points. The error in predicted oil-saturation also decreased.
blocks.zh: 4D模型比3D模型更紧密地跟踪孔径量进化. 平均绝对孔径误差从0.97个百分点降至0.28个百分点。 预测的石油饱和度错误也有所减少。

blocks.en: 2.3 From segmented geometry to flow and transport
blocks.zh: 2.3 从分几何到流动和运输

blocks.en: We examined how differences in segmented pore geometry affect the calculated permeability and total mineral dissolution rate. We used single-phase flow and reactive-transport simulations for each segmentation at 0, 187 and 646 min, corresponding to the initial state and the ends of the two rapid-dissolution stages Ma et al. (2026) (Fig. 3 ). The pore space comprised all voxels assigned to oil or brine and was assumed to be fully saturated with a single fluid. All simulations used the original voxel grid and the same physical parameters. Their solutions passed common checks of flow convergence, mass balance and concentration stability (Methods).
blocks.zh: 我们审查了分孔几何的差别如何影响计算出的渗透性和矿物总溶解率。 我们在0,187和646分钟的每次分解时都采用了单相流和反应传动模拟,对应初始状态和两个快速解体阶段的末端马等人(2026年)(图3). 孔隙空间包括指定用于油或盐水的所有蒸汽,并被假定为完全饱和于单一液体。 所有模拟都使用了原有的voxel网格和相同的物理参数. 它们的解决办法通过对流量趋同、质量平衡和浓度稳定性(方法)的共同检查。

blocks.en: The 3D model underestimated the final-to-initial permeability ratio, K ⁡ ( 646 ) / K ⁡ ( 0 ) K(646)/K(0) , by 27%. The 4D model estimated this ratio with a mean absolute relative error of 6.7% (Fig. 3 d). The 3D model overestimated permeability at 0 min by 13% and underestimated it at 646 min by 18%, both contributing to the lower ratio. nnU-Net underestimated the ratio by 41%, with permeability overestimated by 31% at 0 min and underestimated by 23% at 646 min (Supplementary Table 11 ).

blocks.en: We tested two types of random perturbation at the reference pore boundaries: one changed porosity, and the other preserved it. In the first, we converted rock voxels to pore or pore voxels to rock, increasing or decreasing pore volume by 1, 3 or 5%. In the second, we converted 3% of the original pore voxels to rock and the same number of rock voxels to pore, leaving porosity unchanged. Despite the unchanged porosity, permeability decreased by 17–21% and the mineral dissolution rate increased by 27–36% across the three time steps (Fig. 3 a,b; Supplementary Methods). These perturbations show that permeability and mineral dissolution rate depend on pore-boundary geometry as well as pore volume, and that the same boundary changes can affect the two properties in opposite directions. A segmented image used for flow and reactive-transport simulations should therefore be evaluated by the permeability and dissolution rate calculated from it, not by its phase volumes alone.
blocks.zh: 我们在参考孔隙边界测试了两种随机扰动:一种是改变孔隙,另一种是保留孔隙. 在第一个中,我们把岩ox转化为孔隙或孔隙,将孔隙的体积增加或减少1,3%或5%. 在第二部中,我们把3%的原始孔霉素转化为岩石,同样数量的岩石孔霉素转化为孔霉素,使得孔霉素保持不变. 尽管孔隙性没有变化,但渗透性下降了17-21%,在三个时间步骤中矿物溶解率上升了27-36%(图3 a,b;补充方法)。 这些扰动表明,渗透性和矿物溶解率取决于孔径几何和孔径体积,同样的边界变化可以影响两个属性的相反方向. 因此,用于流动和反应式运输模拟的片段图像应当通过从中计算的渗透率和溶解率来评价,而不是仅仅根据其相位量来评价。

blocks.en: 2.4 Contribution of information from other images
blocks.zh: 2.4 其他图像提供的信息

blocks.en: We performed three comparisons to test whether the 4D model’s performance gain was from the incorporation of spatial and temporal information from other images in the time sequence (Fig. 4 ). PoreTimeNet achieved its largest gains in boundary accuracy in the four images where the 3D model performed poorly, increasing mean rock BF1 score from 0.690 to 0.923 (Fig. 4 f).
blocks.zh: 我们进行了三次比较,以测试4D模型的性能收益是否来自将其他图像的时空信息纳入时间序列(图4)。 PoreTimeNet在3D模型表现不佳的四幅图像中取得了最大的边界精度收益,将平均岩石BF1的得分从0.690提高到0.923(图4 f).

blocks.en: First, we tested whether input corruption, an additional form of training data augmentation, could produce similar improvements in the 3D model. During training, we added noise, masked image regions or randomly varied the greyscale values of a selected training image. The corresponding reference segmentation remained unchanged. Porosity error, fluid Dice and rock BF1 scores remained close to those of the original 3D model.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们测试了作为培训数据扩充的一种补充形式的投入腐败是否能够对三维模型产生类似的改进。 在训练期间,我们增加了噪音,遮盖的图像区域或随机改变选定训练图像的灰度值. 相应的参考分类保持不变。 流体误差,流体Dice和摇滚BF1的分数仍然接近最初的3D模型.

blocks.en: Second, we trained a current-time-step-only 4D model that processed each image independently during training and inference. It retained the architecture and nominal parameter count of the full 4D model, but its accuracy remained close to that of the 3D model (Supplementary Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 其次,我们训练了一个当前时间级的4D模型,在训练和推论期间独立处理每个图像. 它保留了全4D模型的架构和标称参数计数,但其准确度仍然接近3D模型(补充表1 ).

blocks.en: Third, during inference, we repeated the current image multiple times to form the input sequence, keeping the trained 4D model’s weights unchanged. Mean rock BF1 scores fell from 0.941 to 0.808, and the porosity error increased. The largest performance drops occurred at the time steps where the 3D model had the lowest boundary accuracy (Fig. 4 f).
blocks.zh: 第三,在推论中,我们多次重复当前图像,形成输入序列,使训练有素的4D模型的权重保持不变. 平均摇滚BF1分数从0.941降至0.808,孔径误差增加. 最大的性能下降发生在3D模型边界精度最低的时阶(图4 f).

blocks.en: Together, these comparisons show that the 4D model estimates porosity and identifies phase boundaries more accurately because it uses information from other images in the time sequence through temporal attention and fusion, rather than because of input corruption or a larger network alone.
blocks.zh: 这些比较加在一起表明,4D模型估算孔径度并更准确地识别相位边界,因为它通过时间注意力和聚变使用时间序列中其他图像的信息,而不是仅仅因为输入腐败或更大的网络.

blocks.en: The 4D model also reduced pore-to-rock changes in its predictions during dissolution. Predicting rock in a region previously identified as pore space can be mistaken for precipitation. Temporal majority voting across three consecutive time steps further reduced these changes but made fluid identification less accurate, whereas the 4D model improved both consistency and accuracy. These results show that fewer pore-to-rock changes in the predictions do not necessarily indicate a more accurate representation of pore-space evolution: temporal consistency needs to be assessed together with phase-identification accuracy (Supplementary Note Supplementary Note 3. Pore-to-rock changes in predictions and segmentation accuracy and Supplementary Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 4D模型还减少了其在解体期间预测的孔径到岩石的变化. 先前确定为孔隙空间的区域的预测岩可能误认为是降水. 连续三个时间步骤的暂时多数投票进一步减少了这些变化,但使流体识别的准确性降低,而4D模式既提高了一致性,也提高了准确性。 这些结果表明,预测中的孔径到岩石变化较少,并不一定表明孔径空间演化的表述更为准确:时间一致性需要与相位识别准确性一并评估(补充说明补充说明3). 预测和分区精度和补充表2的孔径至岩石变化。

blocks.en: 2.5 Rock-geometry consistency during fluid displacement
blocks.zh: 2.5 流体转移时岩石几何一致性

blocks.en: We then studied another dataset on Ketton limestone, where synchrotron X-ray imaging was used to observe drainage and imbibition without any dissolution Singh et al. (2018) . The 4D model maintained the rock geometry more consistently as fluids moved through it. Training and evaluation settings are described in Supplementary Note Supplementary Note 4. Segmentation accuracy and consistency in Ketton limestone .
blocks.zh: 随后,我们研究了Ketton石灰岩上的另一个数据集,其中使用了同步色素X射线成像来观测排水和沉积,而没有任何溶解的Singh等人(2018年). 4D模型在流体流过时更一致地保持了岩石几何. 补充说明4介绍了培训和评价环境。 Ketton石灰岩中的分化精度和一致性。

blocks.en: Changes in predicted rock voxels between consecutive time steps decreased from 0.590% in 3D to only 0.409% for 4D during drainage. They also decreased during imbibition, as did changes in porosity between time steps in both processes (Fig. 5 a,c). These results show improved consistency in the segmented geometry of the fixed rock matrix.
blocks.zh: 连续时间步数之间预测的岩石花序变化从3D的0.590%下降到4D排水时的0.409%. 它们也随着时间跨度的变化而减少(图5 a,c)。 这些结果表明,固定岩石基质的分位几何学的一致性有所提高。

blocks.en: Accuracy at time steps with reference segmentations improved more modestly. Fluid Dice and rock boundary F1 scores increased in both processes. Adding input corruption to 3D recovered much of the drainage accuracy gain, while 4D porosity predictions remained more consistent (Supplementary Tables 3 and 4 ).
blocks.zh: 参照区段的准确性在时间上略有改善。 在两个过程中,流体水滴和岩石边界F1的分数都有增加. 将输入腐败加到3D之后,回收了排水精度的很多收益,而4D孔径度预测则更加一致(补充表3和表4)。

blocks.en: Information from other images in the time sequence affected consistency more than the fluid Dice score against the reference segmentations. Replacing the trained 4D model’s inputs with copies of the image at the current time step left the Dice score close to its original values but led to more changes in predicted rock at time steps 221–278 for drainage and 181–238 for imbibition (Supplementary Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 时间序列中其他图像的信息对一致性的影响大于液态Dice分数相对于参考分数的影响。 将训练有素的4D模型输入的图像复制件替换为当前阶段的图像复制件,使得Dice得分接近其原始数值,但导致预测岩石在排水时的221-278步和永存时的181-238步出现更多变化(补充表5)。

blocks.en: We also compared changes between predicted oil and brine volumes. Adding the volumes that changed from brine to oil and from oil to brine gave the total change; subtracting the latter from the former gave the net change. In both processes, the total was lower for 4D, while the net change remained close to the 3D estimates (Fig. 6 b).
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了预测的石油和盐水量的变化。 增加从盐水变为油水和从油气变为盐水的体积,则造成总的变化;从前者中减去后者则产生净变化。 在这两个过程中,4D的总数都较低,而净变动仍然接近3D估计数(图6b)。

blocks.en: The final test was a fast laboratory CT displacement sequence in Luxembourg sandstone Mascini et al. (2021) in which brine and rock were difficult to distinguish; models were trained with annotations from one time step. The 4D predictions also maintained the fixed rock geometry more consistently. For pairs of time steps with the later one at 5–69 min, changes in predicted rock decreased from 3.28% of valid voxels for 3D to 0.81% for 4D. Changes in porosity between time steps were also smaller (Fig. 5 b,c).
blocks.zh: 最终测试是卢森堡砂岩马西尼等人(2021年)的快速实验室CT迁移序列,其中的盐水和岩石难以区分;模型从一个步骤开始就用说明进行训练. 4D预测也使固定岩石几何学更加一致. 对于5–69分钟与较晚的一对时间步骤,预测岩石的变化从3D的有效花瓶的3.28%下降到4D的0.81%. 时间步骤间孔径的变化也较小(图5b,c)。

blocks.en: 2.6 Measuring changes in fluid occupancy
blocks.zh: 2.6 测量流体占用量的变化

blocks.en: Shorter scans can increase image noise, making reliable phase identification a challenge for faster laboratory CT imaging Goethals et al. (2022) . We used the Luxembourg sandstone sequence to examine whether temporal information could improve measurements of the locations and volumes of oil filling.
blocks.zh: 更短的扫描可以增加图像噪音,使可靠的相位识别成为更快的实验室CT成像Goethals等人(2022年)的挑战. 我们利用卢森堡的砂岩序列来审查时间信息是否能够改进对石油填充位置和数量的测量。

blocks.en: The 4D model estimated oil-filling volume more accurately. We measured oil filling as the volume of pore space that changed from brine to oil over each selected time interval (Fig. 6 a). The total oil-filling volume across these intervals was 1.94 mm 3 in the reference segmentations, compared with 1.09 mm 3 for the 3D predictions and 1.66 mm 3 for the 4D predictions (Fig. 6 a; Supplementary Table 9 ). Most filling missed by 3D (about 72%) occurred where the earlier prediction was rock and the later prediction was oil. Such a change is not counted as brine-to-oil filling.
blocks.zh: 4D模型更准确地估算了石油填充量. 我们测量的石油填充量是每个选定时间间隔内从盐水变为石油的孔隙面积(图6a)。 这些间隔的总填油量在参考区划中为1.94毫米3,而3D预测为1.09毫米3,4D预测为1.66毫米3(图6a;补充表9)。 大多数被3D(约72%)错失的填料发生在早期的预测是岩石,后来的预测是石油. 这种变化不计为桶对油填充。

blocks.en: A local pore illustrates how this error arose (Fig. 6 d). During the scan for the 35-min time step, the filling pore resembled rock in the greyscale image. Fluid displacement during a CT scan can produce intermediate greyscale values because the reconstruction combines projections acquired at different stages of the displacement event Goethals et al. (2022) . The 3D models classified most of the pore as rock, whereas the 4D models identified it as pore space. Both recognised oil in the following image. The earlier misclassification therefore caused the 3D segmentation to miss filling that the 4D model captured. The 4D predictions also captured more of the largest connected reference filling region (Fig. 6 e).
blocks.zh: 当地的一个孔隙说明了这一错误是如何产生的(图6d)。 在扫描35分钟时间段时,填充孔像灰度图像中的岩石. CT扫描过程中的流体迁移可以产生中间灰度值,因为重建结合了流离失所事件不同阶段获得的预测Goethals等人(2022年). 3D模型将大部分孔隙归类为岩石,而4D模型则将其确定为孔隙空间. 两者都以以下图像识别石油。 因此,早期的分类错误导致3D分割错失了4D模型捕获的填充. 4D预测还捕捉了更多最大的连接参考填充区(图6 e).

blocks.en: We then examined how often this misclassification occurred across individual pores. The reference segmentations identified 1,603 pores of at least 100 voxels that showed brine-to-oil changes between adjacent time steps during 5–69 min. In the image preceding the brine-to-oil change, many of these pores closely resembled rock, with greyscale values similar to or lower than those of rock. These pores accounted for 54% of the total volume of the 1,603 pores analysed (Supplementary Fig. 2 and Note Supplementary Note 8. Predicted phases in pores during oil filling ).
blocks.zh: 然后我们研究了这种错误分类在个体毛孔间发生的频率。 参考分解确定了1 603个孔口,其中至少100个孔口显示5-69分钟期间邻近时间步骤之间的盐水对油的变化。 在盐水变换前的图像中,许多这些毛孔与岩石近似,灰度值与岩石类似或低于岩石. 这些毛孔占所分析的1 603个毛孔总量的54%(补充图2和注8)。 油填充时毛孔的预测阶段。

blocks.en: The 3D model classified each image independently, without information from other images in the time sequence, and performed poorly in distinguishing these pores from rock. It misclassified 90% of the volume of these rock-like pores as rock in the preceding image, approximately 4.7 times the fraction misclassified by the 4D model. Simple temporal voting could not resolve this misclassification. For one 3D training run, we assigned each voxel the majority prediction across five consecutive images, centred on the image preceding the brine-to-oil change. After voting, 91% of the volume in the rock-like pores was still incorrectly classified as rock (Supplementary Table 10 ).
blocks.zh: 3D模型将每个图像独立分类,没有时间序列中其他图像的信息,在区分这些毛孔与岩石方面表现不佳. 它将90%的这些岩石状毛孔的体积错分类为前一个图像中的岩石,大约是4D模型误分类的分数的4.7倍. 简单的临时表决不能解决这种错误分类。 在一次3D训练中,我们给每个阴道分配了 连续5个图像的多数预测, 以血清变换之前的图像为中心。 投票后,岩质毛孔中的91%的体积仍然被错误地归类为岩石(补充表10 ).

blocks.en: When both models were trained with one labelled time step, the 4D model achieved a brine Dice score of 0.713, compared with 0.639 for the 3D model (Fig. 5 d). The 4D model also had lower oil-saturation error (Supplementary Tables 6 and 7 ).

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: PoreTimeNet uses temporal information to improve measurements of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement. During dissolution, pore-volume growth quantifies the dissolution of solid material, while changes in pore-boundary geometry affect fluid flow. The 3D and 4D models were trained using the same annotations and training settings. The 3D model underestimated the final-to-initial permeability ratio, K ⁡ ( 646 ) / K ⁡ ( 0 ) K(646)/K(0) , by approximately 27%, whereas the 4D estimate was closer to the reference value. More accurate estimates of pore-volume growth and permeability changes help characterise how dissolution alters the relationship between porosity and permeability. The random boundary perturbations illustrated why segmentation evaluation needs both volume and boundary measurements. Exchanging equal numbers of rock and pore voxels preserved porosity while reducing permeability and increasing mineral dissolution rate. Differences in pore-boundary geometry can therefore affect both flow through the pore space and transport to reactive mineral surfaces. These perturbations complement phase-volume errors by showing how pore-boundary geometry affects calculated permeability and mineral dissolution rate.
blocks.zh: 时间 Net使用时间信息来改进孔隙空间演化和流体迁移的测量. 在溶解过程中,孔径生长将固体材料的溶解量化,而孔径几何的变化则影响流体流. 3D型和4D型采用相同的说明和培训设置进行训练. 3D模型低估了最终与初始的渗透比,K →(646) / K →(0) K(646)/K(0) 大约27%,而4D估计值更接近参考值. 更精确的孔径生长和渗透性变化估计有助于说明溶解如何改变孔径和渗透性之间的关系。 随机边界扰动说明了为什么分块评估既需要体积测量,也需要边界测量。 相同数量的岩石和孔隙花序保持孔隙性,同时降低渗透性,提高矿物溶解率。 因此,孔径几何方面的差异既会影响孔隙空间的流量,也会影响到反应性矿物表面。 这些扰动通过显示孔径几何对计算渗透性和矿物溶解率的影响来补充相位量误差.

blocks.en: The three comparisons during dissolution show that the 4D model’s gains in porosity and boundary accuracy arise from information shared across distinct images. We also compared with another 3D method nnU-Net that again performed worse than PoreTimeNet.
blocks.zh: 解散期间的三项比较表明,4D模型在孔径度和边界准确度方面的收益来自不同图像之间共享的信息。 我们还比较了另一个3D方法nnU-Net,它的表现再次比PoreTimeNet差.

blocks.en: In Luxembourg sandstone, improved brine identification recovered more of the observed oil filling and more of the largest connected region occupied by advancing oil. Reducing the misclassification of pores as rock in the earlier images preserves the brine-to-oil changes used to measure filling. The Ketton limestone displacement experiments complement this result by showing more consistent rock geometry during drainage and imbibition. The optional process-specific consistency loss shown in Fig. 1 c could incorporate constraints such as constant porosity during fluid displacement through a fixed rock matrix.
blocks.zh: 在卢森堡的砂岩中,经改进的盐水鉴别法回收了更多观察到的石油填充物和更多由推进石油占据的最大相连区域。 减少早期图像中毛孔作为岩石的误分类,保留了用来测量填充的盐水到油的改变. Ketton石灰岩迁移实验通过在排水和沉积期间显示更一致的岩石几何来补充这一结果. 图1c所示的可选过程一致性损失可能包含一些限制,如通过固定岩石基质在流体迁移时的常孔性。

blocks.en: Spatiotemporal segmentation could support faster laboratory CT imaging by improving phase identification when individual images are ambiguous. In Luxembourg sandstone, other images in the time sequence helped distinguish pores that resembled rock, and improved brine recognition persisted across the tested 60-, 180- and 300-s intervals between input images. Because the model uses relative image positions rather than elapsed time in seconds, it could also be trained for more frequent imaging. Applying this approach to faster laboratory CT could broaden the range of pore-scale flow experiments accessible with laboratory systems and reduce reliance on synchrotron facilities.
blocks.zh: spatiotemporal specification可支持更快的实验室CT成像,方法是在单个图像模棱两可时改进相位识别. 在卢森堡砂岩,时间序列中的其他图像有助于区分类似岩石的毛孔,经过测试的60秒、180秒和300秒的输入图像间距上,对盐水的识别度不断提高。 由于该模型使用相对的图像位置,而不是几秒钟中经过的时间,因此也可以接受更频繁的成像训练. 将这种方法应用于更快的实验室CT可以扩大实验室系统可进入的孔径级流动实验的范围,并减少对同步热子设施的依赖。

blocks.en: The transfer tests extend this comparison to mixed-wet and water-wet dissolution sequences from another Ketton sample. When applied to the new sequences without retraining, the 4D models retained higher phase Dice and most boundary F1 scores (Table 1 ). Temporal information continued to support the identification of rock and fluid regions as the experimental conditions changed. This extends the segmentation comparison to related dissolution experiments with different wettability and imaging conditions.
blocks.zh: 转移测试将这一比较扩展到另一个Ketton样本的湿湿混合溶解序列. 在未经再培训而应用到新序列中时,4D模型保留了更高的阶段Dice和大多数边界F1分数(表1). 随着实验条件的变化,临时信息继续有助于确定岩石和流体区域。 这就将分解比较扩大到了具有不同湿度和成像条件的相关溶解实验.

blocks.en: Our results show that segmentation errors can distort measurements of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement and alter the physical properties calculated from images. Even when porosity is unchanged, differences in pore-boundary geometry can change calculated permeability and mineral dissolution rate. Segmentation should therefore be evaluated through the physical measurements and simulations it supports, alongside phase-identification accuracy. By using information from other images in the time sequence, PoreTimeNet improves measurements of pore-volume growth and oil filling and estimates of permeability changes. Extending this approach to faster laboratory CT could help measure changes in pore geometry and fluid occupancy at higher temporal resolution. These measurements could help explain how pore-scale processes govern fluid transport in geological storage and groundwater systems.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,分解错误可以扭曲孔隙空间演化和流体移位的测量,并改变从图像中计算出来的物理属性. 即使孔隙度不变,孔径几何的差别也会改变计算出的渗透性和矿物溶解率. 因此,应当通过它所支持的物理测量和模拟以及相位识别的准确性来评价分裂。 通过利用时间序列中其他图像的信息,PoreTimeNet改进了孔径生长量和石油填充量的测量以及渗透性变化的估计. 将这种方法推广到更快的实验室CT可有助于以更高的时间分辨率测量孔径几何和流体占用的变化。 这些测量可以帮助解释孔径尺度过程如何管理地质储存和地下水系统中的流体运输。

blocks.en: We selected time-resolved micro-CT datasets to evaluate whether temporal information improves measurements of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement. Drainage and imbibition in Ketton limestone tested whether the predicted rock geometry remained consistent as fluids moved through the fixed pore space. Oil flooding in Luxembourg sandstone provided low-contrast laboratory CT images for assessing fluid identification and measurements of oil filling. Two further dissolution sequences from another Ketton sample tested transfer to new experimental conditions without retraining. Table 2 summarises all six sequences.

blocks.en: 4.6 Training settings and model comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.6 培训环境和模型比较

blocks.en: Each training input consisted of three-dimensional patches cropped from the same spatial location at several time steps. These patches formed a temporal window. Supplementary Table 12 summarises the training and inference settings.
blocks.zh: 每项培训投入都由三维补丁组成,这些补丁从同一个空间位置分几个时段裁剪。 这些补丁形成了时间窗口. 补充表12总结了培训和推断环境。

blocks.en: For each comparison, the 3D and 4D models used the same random seeds: 42, 1234 and 2026. All models were trained from random initialisation. The 3D model used the same spatial encoder and decoder as the 4D model but omitted temporal attention and temporal decoder fusion.
blocks.zh: 每次比较时,3D和4D模型使用相同的随机种子:42,1234和2026. 所有模型都是通过随机初始化来训练的. 3D模型使用与4D模型相同的空间编码器和解码器,但省略了时间注意力和时间解码器聚变.

blocks.en: For Ketton drainage and imbibition and Luxembourg sandstone, each input contained 11 image patches of 96 3 96^{3} voxels. Ketton input time steps were separated by 1, 3, 5 or 10 sequence positions, with each interval assigned the same total sampling weight. The sandstone training windows used 60-, 180- or 300-s intervals between input images, sampled equally. Dissolution inputs contained 128 3 128^{3} -voxel patches from five consecutive time steps.
blocks.zh: 对于凯顿排水和永生石和卢森堡砂岩,每个输入都包含11个图像补丁96 3 96^{3}voxels. Ketton输入时间步骤被1,3,5或10个序列位置隔开,每个间隔分配的总采样重量相同. 砂岩训练窗口在输入图像之间使用了60,180或300秒的间隔,同样取样. 解析输入包含128 3 128^{3} - voxel补丁,从连续五个时间步.

blocks.en: In Luxembourg sandstone, we varied the number of labelled training time steps. Training with one, three or five labelled time steps used reference segmentations at { 37 } \{37\} , { 18 , 37 , 56 } \{18,37,56\} and { 9 , 18 , 37 , 56 , 65 } \{9,18,37,56,65\} min, respectively. For each architecture, models were trained separately with each set of labelled time steps using the three seeds listed above and the same training program as the Ketton drainage and imbibition models. When training used one labelled time step, only the 37-min reference segmentation supervised training. The 3D model learned from that image, while the 4D model also used other images in the input window without training labels.
blocks.zh: 在卢森堡的砂岩,我们有不同的培训时间步骤。 1、3或5个标定时间步骤的培训使用参考分解,分别是{37}}、{18、37、56}}、{18、37、56}和{9、18、37、56、65}}、{9、18、37、56、65分钟。 每种建筑的模型分别使用上面列出的三种种子和与Ketton排水和永续模型相同的培训方案,用每套标注的时间步骤进行训练. 当培训使用一个标定的时间步骤时,只有37分钟的参考分门别类地监督培训。 3D模型从该图像中吸取了教训,而4D模型在输入窗口中也使用了没有训练标签的其他图像.

blocks.en: The 3D and 4D models used AdamW with a weight decay of 10 − 5 10^{-5} . Models for the displacement datasets were trained for 300 epochs, with a peak learning rate of 1.4142 × 10 − 5 1.4142\times 10^{-5} , a linear increase during 30 warm-up epochs and then cosine decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Dissolution models were trained for 250 epochs, with a peak learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , 50 warm-up epochs and cosine decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} over the remaining 200 epochs. Each GPU processed one window per batch on two GPUs; model parameters were updated after each batch without gradient accumulation. Luxembourg sandstone training used 115 batches per epoch.
blocks.zh: 3D型和4D型机车使用AdamW型机车,重量衰变为10−5 10−5}. 为300个世纪培训了流离失所数据集的模型,峰值学习率为1.4142×10 − 5 1.4142\times 10× 5},在30个温暖时代中线性增加,然后余弦衰变为10− 6 10× 6}。 对250个纪元的解体模型进行了训练,在剩下的200个纪元中,峰值学习率为2×10−5 2\times 10×5},50个暖化纪元和余弦衰变为10−6 10×6}. 每个GPU在两个GPU上每批处理一个窗口;模型参数在每批之后更新,没有梯度累积. 卢森堡砂岩训练每纪元使用115批次.

blocks.en: For the 3D and 4D models, we evaluated fluid Dice scores in the validation region every ten epochs and retained the saved model, or checkpoint, with the highest score.
blocks.zh: 对于3D和4D模型,我们每10个纪元评价验证区的流体Dice分数,并保留保存的模型,或称检查站,得分最高.

blocks.en: Dice and cross-entropy losses had equal weights, with cross-entropy label smoothing α \alpha of 0.05. Rock, oil and brine class weights were ( 1 , 1 , 1 ) (1,1,1) for limestone and sandstone displacement experiments and ( 0.8 , 1.8 , 1.0 ) (0.8,1.8,1.0) for dissolution.
blocks.zh: 食分和跨摄氏损失的重量相等,跨摄氏标签平滑α-α为0.05. 石灰岩和砂岩移位实验的岩、油和盐类重量为(1,1,1,1)和溶解(0.8,1.8,1.0)(0.8,1.8,1.0)。

blocks.en: For all datasets, training patches were sampled using class-balanced spatial crops. Data augmentation included axis flips, affine transformations and Gaussian smoothing. The same spatial transformation was applied to all images in a window. Temporal intensity drift, which varied greyscale values across the window, was applied with probability 0.5. Reversing the order of the input images was enabled for the displacement datasets and disabled for dissolution. Input corruption applied noise, masking or intensity jitter to a selected training image. In the masking branch, the same spatial region in other images selected from the input window could also receive weaker perturbations. The same input-corruption parameters were used wherever it was enabled. The Supplementary Methods give the probabilities and parameter ranges.
blocks.zh: 在所有数据集中,培训补丁都使用班级平衡的空间作物进行抽样。 数据增强包括轴翻转,affine变换和高斯平滑. 同样的空间转换被应用于窗口中的所有图像. 不同灰度值的瞬间强度漂移以概率0.5进行。 已启用用于移位数据集的输入图像顺序,并禁用以解散。 输入腐败将噪声、遮掩或强度抖动应用到选定的训练图像中。 在遮掩分支中,从输入窗口中选择的其他图像中相同的空间区域也可能受到较弱的扰动. 只要启用,就使用同样的输入-腐败参数。 补充说明 方法给出概率和参数范围.

blocks.en: For dissolution, we made three additional comparisons to test whether the 4D model’s improved accuracy came from information in other images in the input window. First, we trained an additional 3D model with input corruption. Second, we trained the current-time-step-only 4D model. It retained the full architecture and its 69,237,335 parameters, but restricted every temporal attention matrix to its diagonal during training and inference. Other time steps could therefore not influence the prediction. Query/key and temporal-position parameters receiving no gradient under this restriction comprised 1,175,186 parameters; 68,062,149 parameters continued to receive gradients. Third, during inference, we repeated the current image five times to form the input sequence, keeping the trained 4D model’s weights unchanged. All comparisons used the same full-volume evaluation. The four time steps at which the 3D model’s three-seed mean rock boundary F1 score over the complete 500 3 500^{3} region was below 0.80 were 0, 300, 356 and 471 min; overall comparisons included all ten time steps.
blocks.zh: 对于溶解,我们又进行了三次比较,以测试4D模型改进的精度是否来自输入窗口中其他图像中的信息. 首先,我们培训了一个额外的3D模型 输入腐败。 第二,我们训练了当前时间级的4D模式。 它保留了完整的架构及其69,237,335个参数,但在培训和推论期间将每个时间关注矩阵限制在它的对角. 因此,其他时间步骤不会影响预测。 查询/关键参数和时间-位置参数在这种限制下没有得到梯度,它们包括1 175 186个参数;68 062 149个参数继续得到梯度。 第三,在推论中,我们重复了5次当前图像,以形成输入序列,使训练有素的4D模型的重量保持不变. 所有比较都采用了同样的全卷评价。 3D模型的三种子平均岩石边界F1在完整的500 3 500^{3}地区得分低于0.80的4个时间步骤是0、300、356和471分钟;总体比较包括所有10个时间步骤。

blocks.en: For Ketton drainage and imbibition, input corruption was disabled for the 3D model and enabled for the 4D model. We also trained an additional Ketton 3D model with input corruption. For dissolution, input corruption was disabled for both the 3D and 4D models and for the current-time-step-only 4D model. For Luxembourg sandstone, input corruption was enabled for the 4D models and disabled for the 3D models.
blocks.zh: 对于Ketton排水和永存,3D模型的输入腐败被禁用,4D模型被启用. 我们还培训了另一个 Ketton 3D 模型与输入腐败。 对于解散,3D型和4D型以及当前时间级仅4D型的输入腐败都被禁用. 对卢森堡砂岩来说,4D模型的输入腐败被允许,3D模型的输入腐败被禁用。

blocks.en: 4.7 Inference and evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.7 推论和评价衡量标准

blocks.en: To segment an image, the 4D model received that image together with other images from the time sequence within a temporal window. For the results in Figs. 2 – 6 , we retained only its prediction for the middle image, termed the central time-step output. Within each Ketton drainage or imbibition input window, images were separated by five sequence positions; dissolution and the sandstone windows used consecutive images. Where a window extended beyond the sequence, the nearest endpoint image was repeated. We also evaluated Gaussian averaging of predictions from overlapping temporal windows as a separate Ketton variant and used it for the cross-sample predictions in Table 1 , as described below.

blocks.en: The flow and transport calculations included three reference geometries and predictions from the 3D model, the additional 3D model trained with input corruption, and the 4D model. Each model contributed predictions from three training seeds at each time step, giving 30 cases. All met flow criteria of pressure residual ≤ 5 × 10 − 7 \leq 5\times 10^{-7} , each velocity-component residual ≤ 2 × 10 − 5 \leq 2\times 10^{-5} , and relative inlet/outlet flow error ≤ 10 − 6 \leq 10^{-6} . Transport acceptance combined a concentration-residual target or a stable-rate criterion with concentration and mass-balance checks. Random perturbations of reference pore boundaries tested the effect of the spatial arrangement of segmentation errors: pore volume was increased or decreased by 1, 3 or 5%, or held constant by equal changes in both directions. These perturbation calculations and the fields used for visualisation included calculations with different numerical tolerances. Their settings, checks and the random-sampling procedure are given in Supplementary Methods; Supplementary Table 15 lists the flow-solver settings for the visualised fields.

blocks.en: Supplementary Fig. 3: Detailed PoreTimeNet architecture. The model receives a temporal window of 3D images as input and predicts phase logits for all time steps within the window. A shared Swin-Transformer encoder extracts hierarchical spatial features from each 3D image, after which temporal self-attention propagates information across corresponding spatial locations in the temporal window. The decoder uses skip connections and decoder-stage temporal fusion to combine multi-scale spatial and temporal features before projecting the output to oil, brine and rock logits.
blocks.zh: 补充图3:详细PoreTimeNet架构. 该模型接收一个三维图像的时间窗口作为输入,并预测窗口内所有时间步骤的相位日志. 一个共享的Swin-Transformer编码器从每个3D图像中提取等级空间特征,之后时间自觉在时间窗口中将信息传播到相应的空间位置. 解码器使用跳过连接和解码器级时间聚变,将多尺度的空间和时间特征相结合,然后投射到石油,盐水和岩石日志中.

blocks.en: Supplementary Notes
blocks.zh: 补充说明

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 1. Dissolution segmentation accuracy and the contribution of other images
blocks.zh: 补充说明 1. 分解精度和其他图像的贡献

blocks.en: We assessed segmentation accuracy during dissolution and examined the contribution of other images in the time sequence (Supplementary Table 1 ). In the tables, 3D denotes models that segment each image independently, and 4D denotes PoreTimeNet. The dissolution sequence is described by Ma et al. [ 1 ] . All Seq1 dissolution results use the complete 500 3 500^{3} -voxel evaluation region and ten time steps with reference segmentations. Each metric was averaged over time steps within each training run, then summarised across training seeds 42, 1234 and 2026. Values are means and sample standard deviations; the seeds describe training variability within one sample. Spatially and temporally correlated observations are not treated as independent samples. Fluid Dice and BF1 scores average oil and brine equally. Porosity and saturation errors are absolute differences in percentage points (pp). The additional 3D model was trained with input corruption enabled; the current-time-step-only 4D model retains temporal layers but cannot use information from other images in the input window during training or inference.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了解体期间的分解准确性,并审查了其他图像在时间序列中的贡献(补充表1)。 在表格中,3D表示独立分割每个图像的模型,4D表示PoreTimeNet. 溶解序列由马等人描述. [1]. 所有Seq1的溶解结果都使用完整的500 3 500^{3} -voxel评价区和10个带有参考分解的时间步骤. 每个衡量标准在每次培训期间按时间步骤平均计算,然后在培训种子42、1234和2026之间汇总。 价值是手段和样本标准差;种子描述一个样本内的训练变异性. 空间和时间相关观测不作为独立样本处理。 Fluid Dice和BF1平均得分均匀. 孔径和饱和误差是百分点的绝对差异(pp). 附加的3D模型接受了输入腐败启用的培训;当前时间步态的4D模型保留了时间层,但在培训或推断期间无法使用输入窗口中其他图像的信息.

blocks.en: At 300 min, the mean absolute distance from the predicted pore–rock surface to the reference surface over the complete 500 3 500^{3} evaluation region was 1.34 ± 0.04 1.34\pm 0.04 voxels for 3D and 0.38 ± 0.02 0.38\pm 0.02 voxels for 4D (mean and sample standard deviation across three training seeds). From 0 to 646 min, the inferred pore-volume ratio was approximately 1.57 for the matched 3D models, compared with 1.71 for the reference segmentation and 1.71–1.76 across the 4D training seeds (mean 1.74). The current-time-step-only 4D model had rock BF1 scores 0.001–0.010 below the matched 3D model in the seed-wise comparisons.
blocks.zh: 300分钟时,从预测的孔隙-岩石表面到整个500 3 500^{3}评价区域的参考表面的平均绝对距离是3D的1.34±0.04 1.34\pm 0.04 voxels,4D的0.38±0.02 0.38\pm 0.02 voxels(三个训练种子的平均值和样本标准偏差)。 从0到646分钟,相匹配的3D型的推算孔径-体积比约为1.57,而参考分型为1.71,4D训练种子为1.71-1.76(平均值1.74)。 目前仅限时步的4D模型在种子对比中,岩石BF1的分数低于对应的3D模型0.001-00.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 2. Network features at phase boundaries
blocks.zh: 补充说明 2. 阶段边界的网络特征

blocks.en: We compared how clearly the network features distinguish phases at their boundaries (Supplementary Fig. 1 ). We extracted L2-normalised, 48-channel decoder features immediately before the final classification layer at the central time-step output of each five-image window. At each time step with a reference segmentation, we sampled 300 voxels per phase at each interface from distinct 4 3 4^{3} -voxel grid cells, requiring the reference segmentation to contain exactly the two specified non-background phases within the centre voxel and its 26-neighbourhood. Two-dimensional t-SNE [ 2 ] was fitted separately for each model, seed and interface using Euclidean distance, PCA initialisation, perplexity 50, an automatic learning rate and 2,000 iterations (random state 42). Phase purity was the fraction of 15 cosine-nearest neighbours in the original feature space with the same reference phase, restricting neighbours to the same interface type at other time steps and weighting the two phases equally.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了网络特征如何明确区分其边界的阶段(补充图1)。 我们提取了L2常态化,48通道的解码器特征,紧接在每个五象窗口的中央时间步输出的终分类层之前. 每一步都有参考分解 我们在每个接口的每个阶段抽取了300伏克赛尔 -voxel网格细胞,要求参考区划精确地包含中心Voxel及其26-邻域内两个指定的非背景阶段. 二维T-SNE[2]是使用Euclidean距离,PCA初始化,复杂度50,自动学习率和2000迭代(随机状态42)为每个型号,种子和接口分别安装的. 相位纯度是原始特征空间中15个相位近邻的一小部分,具有相同的参考阶段,在其它时间步骤中将相位限于同一接口类型,对两个阶段的权重相等.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 3. Pore-to-rock changes in predictions and segmentation accuracy
blocks.zh: 补充说明 3. 预测和分区精确度的波雷至岩石变化

blocks.en: We assessed whether reducing pore-to-rock changes in predictions also preserves segmentation accuracy (Supplementary Table 2 ). The diagnostic counts voxels whose predictions change from pore to rock between consecutive sampled time steps, divided by the number of voxels in the complete 500 3 500^{3} evaluation region and averaged over nine intervals. It is not a segmentation-accuracy objective. A rule that permanently retains every voxel once predicted as pore would eliminate reverse transitions while retaining early false-pore predictions. Three-time-step voting provides a measured comparison: it reduces reverse transitions but also reduces the fluid Dice score. These voting values are not measurements of the irreversible rule.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了减少预测中的孔径到岩石变化是否也保持了分解的准确性(补充表2)。 诊断数计其预测从孔隙到岩石在连续采样的时间步数之间变化的狐狸,除以整个500 3500^{3}评价区域的狐狸数量,平均间隔9个. 这不是分化准确的目标。 一条规则,一旦永久保留每只狐狸曾经被预测为孔隙,将消除逆向过渡,同时保留早期的假孔预测. 三时步投票提供了一种量度比较:它既减少了逆向过渡,也减少了流体Dice得分. 这些投票值并不是对不可逆转规则的衡量。

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 4. Segmentation accuracy and consistency in Ketton limestone
blocks.zh: 补充说明 4. Ketton石灰岩的分化准确性和一致性

blocks.en: We compared segmentation accuracy and changes in predicted rock across the Ketton drainage and imbibition sequences (Supplementary Tables 3 – 5 ). The drainage and imbibition images are from Singh et al. [ 3 ] . For both drainage and imbibition, input corruption was disabled for the 3D model and enabled for the 4D model. Additional 3D models used input corruption to assess its effect (3D + input corruption). Tables use the central time-step output; temporal-window aggregation is a separate setting. Drainage scoring covers all 125,000,000 voxels. Imbibition scoring retains 79,881,984 voxels after excluding the training cube and predictions whose inference windows touch it. Both regions include the validation region used to select these models’ checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了凯顿排水和永生序列(补充表3 — — 5 )的分解精度和预测岩石的变化。 排水和隐形图像来自辛格等人. [3]. 对于排水和静电,3D模型的输入腐败被禁用,4D模型被启用. 其他3D模型使用输入腐败来评估其效果(3D+输入腐败). 表格使用中央时间步输出;时间窗口汇总是一个单独的设置. 排水积分覆盖全部12.5亿伏克赛尔. Imbibition 评分在排除训练立方体和预测其推论窗口触碰它后,保留了79,881,984瓦克斯. 这两个地区都包括用来选择这些模式检查站的验证区。

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 5. Effect of the number of labelled training time steps on segmentation
blocks.zh: 补充说明 5. 标明的培训时间步骤数目对分门别类的影响

blocks.en: We compared brine segmentation accuracy and phase-volume errors for Luxembourg sandstone models trained with one, three or five labelled time steps (Supplementary Tables 6 and 7 ). All results here use models trained from random initialisation and the combined validation and test region. N1, N3 and N5 denote one, three and five labelled training time steps; separate validation annotations were additionally used for checkpoint selection. The evaluated time steps were at 0, 5, 11, 16, 21, 27, 32, 37, 42, 47, 53, 58, 63, 69 and 74 min, measured from the start of continuous imaging as defined in the main-text Methods. These comparisons exclude 37 min, which belongs to every set of labelled training time steps. Brine Dice scores and volume errors were calculated using the remaining 14 images. Each metric is averaged over time for each seed and then over seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了卢森堡砂岩模型的盐分精度和相位误差,用一个、三个或五个标记的时间步骤进行了培训(补充表6和表7)。 这里的所有结果都使用从随机初始化以及合并验证和测试区域中训练出来的模型. N1、N3和N5表示一个、三个和五个标记的培训时间步骤;另外,在选择检查站时还使用了单独的验证说明。 评价的时间步骤为0、5、11、16、21、27、32、37、42、47、53、58、63、69和74分钟,从主要文字方法所界定的连续成像开始计算。 这些比较不包括37分钟,这属于每一套标记的培训时间步骤。 烧焦 使用其余的14幅图像计算出骰子分数和音量错误. 每一度量的平均值分别为每一种种子,然后是种子。

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 6. Effect of the time interval between input images on segmentation accuracy
blocks.zh: 补充说明 6. 输入图像之间的时间间隔对分割精度的影响

blocks.en: We tested how changing the time interval between input images affects the accuracy of the same trained 4D models, without further training (Supplementary Table 8 ). The input images were separated by one, three or five time-step intervals. These correspond to 60, 180 and 300 s, all present during training. Predictions were compared for time steps at 11, 16, 21, 27, 32, 37, 42, 47, 53, 58 and 63 min. These times limited each input window to at most three positions outside the image sequence, which were filled by repeating the nearest endpoint image. These common times include 37 min and differ from those used to compare models trained with one, three or five labelled time steps; scores should therefore be compared within the same table. The 3D predictions were reused because their output does not depend on the time interval between input images.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了改变输入图像之间的时间间隔如何影响同一训练有素的4D模型的准确性,而没有进一步的培训(补充表8)。 输入图像以1,3或5个时序间隔分隔. 这相当于60、180和300s,都在培训期间。 对11、16、21、27、32、37、42、47、53、58和63分钟的时间步骤进行了预测比较。 这些时间将每个输入窗口限制在图像序列以外的最多三个位置,这些位置是通过重复最近的端点图像来填充的. 这些常见时间包括37分钟,与用来比较所培训的模型和标注为1、3或5个时间级的模型不同;因此,应在同一表中比较分数。 3D预测被重用,因为其输出不取决于输入图像之间的时间间隔.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 7. Measuring oil filling between time steps
blocks.zh: 补充说明 7. 测量时间步骤之间的石油填充量

blocks.en:
We assessed how well 3D and 4D segmentations recover oil filling observed between time steps (Supplementary Table 9 ).
The common reference pore mask contains 8,442,760 voxels in the combined validation and test region. Within this fixed mask, filling consists of voxels classified as brine at the earlier time step and oil at the later time step. Each reference or model mask is filtered independently to retain 26-connected components of at least 24 voxels; components touching a region boundary are included. The intervals between the selected time steps span five or six minutes each. Summing the filling volumes across these intervals gives the total observed brine-to-oil transition volume.
blocks.zh:
我们评估了3D和4D分离如何回收在时间步骤间观察到的石油填充(补充表9)。
常见的参考孔罩中包含8,442,760个在综合验证和测试区域内的活塞. 在这个固定的口罩内,填充物包括较早步被归类为血清的阴道和较晚步被归类为油道的阴道. 每个参考物或模型遮罩被独立过滤,以保留至少24伏克塞爾的26个连接元件;包含触及一个区域边界的元件. 选定时间步骤之间的间隔为每段5至6分钟。 通过这些间隔对填充量进行组合,可得出观察到的从盐碱到油的过渡总量。

blocks.en: The largest retained reference filling region occurred between 32 and 37 min and contained 666,548 voxels (0.348 mm 3 ). It was selected by reference volume across all intervals and may span several pores. Recovery was calculated as the volume shared by this reference region and each model’s retained filling mask, divided by the reference-region volume. Its intersections with the predicted filling masks recovered 62.4 ± 0.7 % 62.4\pm 0.7\% of the region for 3D and 86.6 ± 0.5 % 86.6\pm 0.5\% for 4D (three seeds). Main-text Fig. 6 e renders seed 42 while the printed percentages report the means across three training seeds.
blocks.zh: 最大的保留参考填充区在32分钟至37分钟之间,含有666 548瓦克斯(0.348毫米3). 它通过各种间隔的参考量选择,可能跨越若干孔隙。 回收额按该参照区域共有的数量和每个模型保留的填充罩计算,除以参照区域的数量。 它与预测的填充口罩的交叉点为3D回收了62.4±0.7% 62.4\pm 0.7+%的区域,为4D(3个种子)回收了86.6±0.5% 86.6\pm 0.5+%. 主文图. 6 e使种子42成为种子,而印刷百分比则报告三种培训种子的手段。

blocks.en: The local filling example in main-text Fig. 6 d was selected from fixed reference pores with at least 85% brine before filling, at least 60% oil afterward and an oil increase of at least 50 percentage points. All three 3D models classified more than 30% of the earlier pore as rock; all three 4D models classified less than 20% as rock and more than 50% as oil afterward. The displayed example had the largest reference oil-volume increase among 473 eligible pores. At 35 min, the greyscale value is intermediate because filling occurs during the scan; the reference segmentation identifies the pore as brine.
blocks.zh: 主文本图中的本地填充示例 。 6 d是从固定参考毛孔中选取的,填充前至少含85%的盐水,之后至少含60%的油,油量至少增加50个百分点. 所有三种3D模型都将早期孔隙的30%以上归类为岩石;所有三种4D模型都将不到20%的孔隙归类为岩石,之后的50%以上归类为石油. 所展示的例子在473个合格毛孔中,参考油量增幅最大。 在35分钟时,灰度值是中间值,因为填充发生在扫描过程中;参考分解将孔隙识别为血清.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 8. Predicted phases in pores during oil filling
blocks.zh: 补充说明 8. 石油填充过程中毛孔的预测阶段

blocks.en: We examined whether changes in greyscale values during filling were associated with a pore being predicted as rock before oil was identified in the reference sequence (Supplementary Fig. 2 and Table 10 ). This descriptive analysis used existing predictions and reference segmentations in the combined validation and test region. Fixed reference pores had volumes of at least 100 voxels, with a voxel side length of 8.051 μ \mu m. For an event from t − 1 t-1 to t t , the reference oil fraction at t t was at least 0.60, the brine fraction at t − 1 t-1 was at least 0.85, and the oil fraction increased by at least 0.50. The earlier time was at least 5 min and the later time at most 69 min. Each pore–time-step pair formed one record, without any model-based selection condition. The 1,603 records corresponded to 1,603 different pores with a combined volume of 1.10 mm 3 . This volume sums the complete selected pores, whereas Supplementary Table 9 sums connected brine-to-oil transition voxels over five- or six-minute intervals.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了在填充过程中灰度值的变化是否与在参考序列中确定石油之前将孔隙预测为岩石有关(补充图2和表10)。 这一描述性分析使用了合并验证和试验区的现有预测和参考分解。 固定的参考毛孔的体积至少为100伏克塞尔,其侧长为8.051 μ\mu m. 对于 t − 1 t-1 到 t 的事件, t 的参考油分至少为0.60, t − 1 t-1 的盐分至少为0.85,油分至少增加0.50. 更早的时间是至少5分钟,更晚的时间是最多69分钟. 每个孔隙-时间步对形成一个记录,没有任何基于模型的选择条件. 1,603个记录对应1,603个不同的毛孔,综合体积为1.10毫米3. 这一量将所选的完整毛孔相加,而补充表9则将连接在五或六分钟间隔内的盐水到石油过渡的氧化物相加。

blocks.en: For each pore, G ⁡ ( s ) G(s) was the median source greyscale value over all its voxels at time step s s . We defined the relative greyscale position in the preceding image as x = G ⁡ ( t − 1 ) − G ⁡ ( t ) G ⁡ ( t − 2 ) − G ⁡ ( t ) . x=\frac{G(t-1)-G(t)}{G(t-2)-G(t)}. Values near 1 resemble the earlier brine-filled state, and values near 0 resemble the later oil-filled state. For each image, global rock, brine and oil greyscale values were estimated using a fixed random seed and samples of up to 2,000,000 valid voxels per phase. Rock samples used valid non-pore voxels; fluid samples used pore voxels assigned to the relevant phase in the reference segmentation sequence. blocks.en: Supplementary Note 9. Segmentation of other dissolution experiments without retraining

blocks.en:
We evaluated models trained on one dissolution sequence on two further sequences without retraining (main-text Table 1 ).
The target sequences are described by Ma et al. [ 4 ] . The three paired 3D and 4D models trained on the water-wet dissolution sequence (Seq1; Supplementary Note Supplementary Note 1. Dissolution segmentation accuracy and the contribution of other images ) were applied without target adaptation or target checkpoint selection to mixed-wet Seq2 and water-wet Seq3 from a second sample. Each target sequence had reference segmentations at two time steps. Seq2 contained 18 images; Seq3 contained seven images spanning a baseline and six injection time steps at 30-minute intervals. Predictions retained the source-model preprocessing and used five-image temporal windows with 128 3 128^{3} -voxel spatial inputs and 50% spatial overlap. Unlike the Seq1 evaluation using the central time-step output, overlapping temporal-window predictions for each time step with a reference segmentation were combined using Gaussian weights (width five time-step indices, minimum weight 0.05). Voxels outside non-zero greyscale support were masked. This comparison is restricted to overlap and boundary metrics. Metrics were calculated within valid sample support, averaged over the two time steps with reference segmentations and then summarised across seeds.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 10. Comparison with nnU-Net

blocks.en: We compared the 3D SwinUNETR model and PoreTimeNet with nnU-Net trained using its own configuration and training procedure. We trained nnU-Net v2.8.0 [ 5 ] with its 3D full-resolution configuration on the same dissolution training region and ten labelled time steps. The spatial split used the same validation region as the matched SwinUNETR comparison. The network was a six-stage convolutional U-Net with 160 × 160 × 96 160\times 160\times 96 -voxel patches. The global batch size was 16 over two GPUs. Training used 1,000 epochs of 250 iterations, Dice and cross-entropy losses with deep supervision, and Nesterov SGD with initial learning rate 0.01, momentum 0.99 and weight decay 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , with polynomial learning-rate decay. The SwinUNETR comparisons isolate temporal processing within their shared architecture and training protocol.

blocks.en: The Dice and boundary F1 scores follow main-text Eqs. ( 14 )–( 16 ). Boundaries use six-neighbour binary erosion and an inclusive Euclidean matching tolerance of d ≤ 1 d\leq 1 voxel (the same voxel or a face neighbour). For both dissolution and Ketton displacement, phases are restricted to the evaluation region and valid sample support before boundary extraction, with zero padding outside them. For these datasets, Dice and BF1 scores are zero when only one of the two sets is empty; when both are empty, the score is undefined and omitted from the mean. Because erosion treats voxels outside the evaluation region, valid support or array as background, voxels on the faces of the evaluation regions, on the faces of the excluded imbibition cube [ 144,500 ) 3 [144,500)^{3} and on the edge of the Seq2 and Seq3 sample support count as boundary voxels. The same boundary definition applies to both architectures, without an edge correction.

(14)–(16). 边界使用六邻二进制侵蚀和包容的欧几里得式比对耐受度(d≤1 d\leq 1 voxel)(同一个Voxel或面邻). 对于解体和Ketton流离失所,阶段仅限于评价区和边界提取前的有效样本支持,其外部没有固定。 对于这些数据集,Dice和BF1的分数只有两组中的一组是空的时为零;当这两组都是空的时,则分数未定义,并省略了平均值. 因为侵蚀将评价区外的 voxel,有效支持或阵列作为背景处理,所以评价区的面部,被排除的 imbibition cube [144,500] 3 [144,500]^{3] 的面部,以及 Seq2 和 Seq3 样本支持的边缘作为边界 voxel. 相同的边界定义适用于两个架构,没有边缘修正.

The context includes greyscale values from the validation region but no validation labels or training region. Ketton predictions were assembled on a 500 3 500^{3} -voxel grid using 96 3 96^{3} spatial windows with 50% overlap. Imbibition excludes [ 144,500 ) 3 [144,500)^{3} , including the [ 200,500 ) 3 [200,500)^{3} training cube and touching inference windows. Luxembourg sandstone predictions use 96 3 96^{3} windows with 50% spatial overlap and Gaussian blending over the 725 × 728 × 256 725\times 728\times 256 -voxel evaluation region. Its training, validation and test regions are adjacent, with no gap.

blocks.en: Shared spatial augmentation used axis flips with probability 0.5, affine transforms with probability 0.3 (rotation range 0.2618 rad and scale range 0.15), and Gaussian smoothing with probability 0.1 (standard deviation 0.5–1.0 voxels). Temporal intensity drift had probability 0.5, maximum scale/shift 0.15/0.10 and per-time-step scale/shift standard deviations 0.03/0.02. Temporal reversal had probability 0.5 for the displacement datasets and was disabled for dissolution. When input corruption was enabled, a selected training image received no change, Gaussian noise, cuboid masking or intensity jitter with probabilities 0.2, 0.2, 0.4 and 0.2. Noise standard deviation was 0.15 in scaled greyscale values; cuboid masks had side fractions from 0.2 to 0.4 and were filled using a blurred image at the current time step (five-voxel kernel) and noise 0.02. Intensity jitter used scale 0.75–1.25 and shift − 0.15 -0.15 to 0.15 0.15 , followed by clipping. Only the masking branch of input corruption could also perturb other images in the input window. It selected zero to two images within two positions of the selected image in the input window and applied weaker perturbations to the same cuboid. Disabling input corruption also disabled these perturbations. These augmentations were also used during training on the Luxembourg sandstone dataset; input corruption was enabled for its 4D models and disabled for its 3D models.

blocks.en: The Luxembourg sandstone analysis compared 3D and 4D models trained with one, three or five labelled time steps. Each combination was trained from random initialisation with seeds 42, 1234 and 2026, giving 18 models. The labelled time steps were at 37 min for N1; 18, 37 and 56 min for N3; and 9, 18, 37, 56 and 65 min for N5. Validation used time steps at 0, 16, 27, 32, 37, 47, 58, 69 and 74 min in the separate validation region.

Rock, oil and brine crop centres were sampled with equal weights. Predictions at every time step with training labels in the window contributed to the segmentation loss.

Input images for the 4D comparisons were separated by 60 s, except when testing the input interval (Supplementary Note Supplementary Note 6. Effect of the time interval between input images on segmentation accuracy ). We retained the prediction for the central time step of each input window. Where the window extended beyond the sequence, the nearest endpoint image was repeated.

blocks.en: Solver convergence and tolerance checks
blocks.zh: 解决趋同和容忍度检查

blocks.en: Supplementary Tables 13 and 14 summarise permeability, total mineral dissolution rate and permeability increases across training seeds. The 30 flow calculations for the model comparison used SIMPLEC with velocity relaxation 0.90. They included the reference geometries and predictions from the 3D model trained without input corruption, the 3D model trained with input corruption, and the 4D model. Convergence required final outer-iteration initial residuals of p ≤ 5 × 10 − 7 p\leq 5\times 10^{-7} and each velocity component ≤ 2 × 10 − 5 \leq 2\times 10^{-5} . Absolute and relative linear-solver tolerances were 10 − 12 10^{-12} and 0.01. Both inlet and outlet flow rates had to agree with the prescribed flow rate to within 10 − 6 10^{-6} , relative to that rate. All 30 cases met these criteria. One 187-min 4D geometry required continuation of its existing solution with unchanged numerical settings; no flow calculation was accepted solely because it reached an iteration limit.

Of the 30 cases, 26 reached the residual target and four met the alternative criterion; all four were 0-min geometries. blocks.en: A tighter-tolerance check considered six geometries: the reference and 3D seed 42 at 0 min, the reference and 4D seed 2026 at 187 min, and the reference and 3D seed 42 at 646 min. Pressure and velocity targets were 10 − 7 10^{-7} and 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} ; transport relative tolerance was 0.001; the minimum iteration count and window used to assess stability of R R were 120 and 100; and thresholds for relative changes in R R were 10 − 6 10^{-6} . blocks.en: The 30 calculations for the model comparison, the nnU-Net calculations, the random boundary perturbations and the fields used for visualisation all met common flow criteria: final outer-iteration initial residuals of p ≤ 3 × 10 − 6 p\leq 3\times 10^{-6} and ≤ 10 − 4 \leq 10^{-4} for each velocity component, and relative inlet/outlet flow-rate error ≤ 10 − 5 \leq 10^{-5} . blocks.en: Random perturbations to pore boundaries
blocks.zh: 对孔隙边界的随机扰动

blocks.en: Random boundary changes were made separately to the reference segmentation at 0, 187 and 646 min. Candidate voxels belonged to the one-voxel layer on either side of the rock–pore interface, using face neighbours only. To increase pore volume, rock voxels sharing a face with pore space were selected uniformly without replacement and reclassified as brine. To decrease pore volume, pore voxels sharing a face with rock were selected in the same way and reclassified as rock. For a requested fraction f f , the number selected was round ⁡ ( f ​ N pore , ref ) \operatorname{round}(fN_{\mathrm{pore,ref}}) , where N pore , ref N_{\mathrm{pore,ref}} counts all oil and brine voxels in the reference region before extraction of the spanning flow domain. Fractions were 1, 3 and 5% in each direction. Exterior voxels were unchanged.

Each altered segmentation was processed by the same connected-domain extraction and native-grid meshing procedure used for model predictions.
